{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the revenue column for formatting
print("Unique values in revenue (first 10):", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])
print("\nSample of revenue values (first 5):")
print(df['revenue'].head(5))

# Check for thousands separators
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nRows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()} out of {len(df)}")

# Check for the special QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Show the first few rows of QA orders
print("\nFirst few QA orders:")
print(qa_orders.head())"}
